title: Bookings Coordinator
description:

title: Customer Care Administrator

Process replacements, refunds and exchanges in line with company policy.

Identify recurring customer issues and provide feedback to help improve products, processes and service.
Work closely with the wider operations, logistics and marketing teams to ensure a seamless customer journey.
Support peak trading periods and promotional campaigns when required.

We are looking for someone who has:

Previous experience within a Customer Care, Customer Service or Customer Experience role.
Experience working within a luxury, premium or high-end consumer products environment.
Previous experience supporting US customers or working within an international customer service environment.
Excellent written communication skills with exceptional attention to detail.
Strong problem-solving and conflict resolution skills.
Experience responding to customers via email and social media platforms.
Ability to remain calm and professional when handling complaints.
Highly organised with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
Strong IT skills with experience using CRM or customer service platforms.
A proactive approach and a genuine passion for delivering outstanding customer experiences.

title: HR Assistant
description:
HR Coordinator Birmingham City Centre - Fully Office Based up to 35 K - plus free parking Full Time, Permanent

Gleeson Recruitment Group is delighted to be partnering exclusively with a leading international organisation to recruit an HR Coordinator to join its growing UK HR team in Birmingham. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced HR Administrator, HR Assistant or HR Coordinator looking to develop their career within a dynamic, international environment. Working closely with the UK HR Business Partner and a central HR function overseas, you will play a key role in delivering a high-quality, commercially focused HR service across the UK.

The Role

As a key member of the UK HR team, you will provide support across the full employee lifecycle, acting as a trusted point of contact for managers and employees while ensuring HR processes remain compliant, accurate and efficient.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Acting as a key HR contact for managers and employees across the UK, working closely with the HR Business Partner and wider HR team.
- Supporting payroll and HR administration, including contracts, employee changes and monthly payroll coordination.
- Maintaining accurate employee records, HR systems, digital personnel files and reporting.
- Coordinating end-to-end recruitment activity, including job postings, applicant tracking, interview coordination and onboarding.
- Supporting employee lifecycle processes including onboarding, probation, absence management and offboarding.
- Providing day-to-day advice and support to managers and employees on HR-related queries.
- Supporting HR compliance, audits, policy updates and continuous improvement initiatives.
- Contributing to both UK and global HR projects, including areas such as employee retention, wellbeing and employer branding.
- Ensuring confidential and sensitive employee information is managed appropriately and in line with relevant legislation and company standards.

About You

We are looking for an HR professional who is proactive, organised and confident working across a broad range of HR activities.

You will ideally have:
- Previous experience in an HR Assistant, HR Administrator or HR Coordinator position, ideally within an international or multi-site organisation.
- A good working knowledge of UK employment law, HR processes and payroll.
- Practical experience across recruitment, onboarding and wider employee lifecycle processes.
- A relevant degree in Business Administration, Psychology, HR or a related discipline would be advantageous.
- CIPD qualification, or working towards one, would be desirable.
- Excellent organisational and multitasking skills, with a proactive and detail-focused approach.
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the confidence to work with stakeholders at all levels.
- Strong IT skills, particularly Microsoft Office and experience using HRIS platforms such as Workday.
- The ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with a high level of professionalism and discretion.
- A collaborative, hands-on approach and the ability to work independently when required.

Why This Opportunity?

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a successful international business and become an integral part of its UK HR function. You will have exposure to a broad range of HR activity, work alongside experienced HR professionals and contribute to both local and international HR projects.

To apply for the position, please click on the apply now button and your CV will be sent directly to the responsible recruiter. We will respond to successful applicants within 7 days, however please feel free to get in touch if you would like any further information about your application.

description: Answer the telephone in a polite and professional manner, taking and passing messages accurately and appropriately. Administer repeat prescription protocol. Ensure pathology samples are available for collection Obtain telephone contacts for doctors and practice nurses on request. Make routine telephone calls and enquires as required Process registration applications and deduction of patients, ensuring adherence to the practice patient registration and deduction protocols. Ensure that all new patients are registered onto the computer system promptly and accurately. Provide full administrative support to patients requesting medical reports etc. Work with the PM to update practice policies and procedures. Apply Practice policies, standards and guidance Discuss with other members of the team how the policies, standards and guidelines will affect own work Participate in audit where appropriate. Routine Administrative Support as Required & Competence with Practice Equipment Provide administrative support to members of the primary health care team. Photocopying Scanning Filing Tidiness and organisation in the Reception, Admin area Maintaining the computerised appointment system and helping patients with any queries. Maintain front of house protocols. Ensure by regular enquiry, the patient computer records display the current address of patient, the current phone number and that changes of name or address are recorded with regard to Links and according to practice protocols. Administrative support The post-holder will: Franking Mail Cover for Reception as required Administration of Baby and other Clinics as and when necessary. Attend and contribute to Practice Meetings Management of medical records: Ensure that records are available in the instances of urgent consultation Retrieve and re-file records as requested, ensuring that strict alphabetical order is adhered to. Support the summariser/coder as required. Ensure correspondence, reports, results etc. are filed in correct records Ensure records are kept neat and tidy, secure and in good repair with all necessary information recorded correctly on the outer cover Management of appointment system Ensure total familiarity with all appointment systems including regular and incidental variations Book appointments and recalls ensuring sufficient information is recorded to enable retrieval of the medical record Confidentiality: In the course of seeking treatment, patients entrust us with, or allow us to gather, sensitive information in relation to their health and other matters. They do so in confidence and have the right to expect that staff will respect their privacy and act appropriately In the performance of the duties outlined in this Job Description, the post-holder may have access to confidential information relating to patients and their carers, Practice staff and other healthcare workers. They may also have access to information relating to the Practice as a business organisation. All such information from any source is to be regarded as strictly confidential Information relating to patients, carers, colleagues, other healthcare workers or the business of the Practice may only be divulged to authorised persons in accordance with the Practice policies and procedures relating to confidentiality and the protection of personal and sensitive data Health & Safety: The post-holder will assist in promoting and maintaining their own and others health, safety and security as defined in the practice Health & Safety Policy, the practice Health & Safety Manual, and the practice Infection Control policy and published procedures. This will include: Using personal security systems within the workplace according to Practice guidelines Identifying the risks involved in work activities and undertaking such activities in a way that manages those risks Making effective use of training to update knowledge and skills Using appropriate infection control procedures, maintaining work areas in a tidy and safe way and free from hazards Actively reporting of health and safety hazards and infection hazards immediately when recognised Keeping own work areas and general / patient areas generally clean, assisting in the maintenance of general standards of cleanliness consistent with the scope of the job holders role Undertaking periodic infection control training Reporting potential risks identified Equality and Diversity: The post-holder will support the equality, diversity and rights of patients, carers and colleagues, to include: Acting in a way that recognizes the importance of peoples rights, interpreting them in a way that is consistent with Practice procedures and policies, and current legislation Respecting the privacy, dignity, needs and beliefs of patients, carers and colleagues Behaving in a manner which is welcoming to and of the individual, is non-judgmental and respects their circumstances, feelings priorities and rights. Personal & Professional Development: The post-holder will participate in any training programme implemented by the Practice as part of this employment, such training to include: Participation in an annual individual performance review, including taking responsibility for maintaining a record of own personal and/or professional development Taking responsibility for own development, learning and performance and demonstrating skills and activities to others who are undertaking similar work Quality: The post-holder will strive to maintain quality within the Practice, and will: Alert other team members to issues of quality and risk Assess own performance and take accountability for own actions, either directly or under supervision Contribute to the effectiveness of the team by reflecting on own and team activities and making suggestions on ways to improve and enhance the teams performance Work effectively with individuals in other agencies to meet patients needs Effectively manage own time, workload and resources Communication: The post-holder should recognize the importance of effective communication within the team and will strive to: Communicate effectively with other team members Communicate effectively with patients and carers Recognize peoples needs for alternative methods of communication and respond accordingly. This is not intended to be an exhaustive list of responsibilities, and it is expected that you will participate in a wide range of activities.
